name: eat-glint
prompt: A small bright glass chime ping, like a fingertip tapping a thin crystal goblet, short shimmer decay.

name: eat-pluck
prompt: A soft plucked rubber band twang with a quick muted pop, playful and dry, very short.

name: eat-morsel
prompt: A crisp bite into a fresh apple, single crunchy munch with a juicy snap, close and dry.

name: eat-bubble
prompt: A single round water bubble popping at the surface, gentle bloop with a tiny splash tail.

name: eat-chime
prompt: A tiny brass bell struck once with a wooden stick, warm metallic ting fading quickly.

name: eat-spark
prompt: A quick electric spark crackle, like static discharge from a doorknob, brief and snappy.

name: boost-whoosh
prompt: A fast air whoosh of a swung wooden staff passing close by the ear, rising then falling.

name: boost-surge
prompt: A deep breath of wind swelling through a narrow canyon, low rushing surge building up.

name: boost-ignite
prompt: A gas stove burner igniting with a soft whomp of flame catching, short and warm.

name: boost-rush
prompt: A sled pushed off down an icy slope, scraping rush of ice and air accelerating away.

name: boost-launch
prompt: A taut bowstring released, deep thrum with a quick arrow whistle fading upward.

name: death-impact
prompt: A heavy clay pot striking stone floor and thudding without breaking, dull low impact.

name: death-shatter
prompt: A glass bottle shattering on concrete, sharp initial crash with scattering shards settling.

name: death-crash
prompt: A stack of hollow metal cans toppling over onto a hard floor, clattering cascade dying down.

name: death-fade
prompt: A deep struck gong decaying slowly, dark metallic hum sinking into silence.
